## Azure Managed Instance for Apache Cassandra  
  

<!--df7984b9-7864-487a-b4a6-3931ac2d55ea_begin-->

#### Scale out Azure Managed Instance for Apache Cassandra by adding nodes to reduce disk pressure  
  
Your cluster has one or more nodes with over 60% disk usage. Add nodes to increase capacity and storage headroom, improve write consistency, and support compaction and backups across your cluster.  
  
**Potential benefits**: Improve your storage availability with more capacity  

**Impact:** Medium
  
For more information, see [Best Practices for Optimal Performance in Azure Managed Instance for Apache Cassandra](/azure/managed-instance-apache-cassandra/best-practice-performance#monitor-for-performance-bottlenecks)  

ResourceType: microsoft.documentdb/cassandraclusters
